item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 04/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will bring generally fine and persistently very hot weather to southeastern China in the next couple of days. With the subtropical ridge weakening slightly and under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week, but the weather will remain very hot.

Date/Month: 04/07 (Thursday)
Wind: Southeast force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Very hot with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
